class.name: Porion.Queries.Build_Stat
class.comment: Statistics about a list of builds.

property.name: pass_count
property.comment: the total number of tests that passed.

property.name: fail_count
property.comment: the total number of tests that failed.

property.name: timeout_count
property.comment: the total number of tests that timeout.

property.name: test_duration
property.comment: the total duration of all tests.

query.name: stat-builds
query.comment: Statistics about the last project builds
query.sql: SELECT build.status AS status, COUNT(build.id) AS cnt, SUM(build.pass_count) AS pass_count, SUM(build.fail_count) AS fail_count, SUM(build.timeout_count) AS timeout_count, SUM(build.test_duration) AS test_duration, SUM(build.build_duration) AS build_duration, SUM(build.sys_time) AS sys_time, SUM(build.user_time) AS user_time FROM porion_last_build AS last_build INNER JOIN porion_build AS build ON last_build.build_id = build.id WHERE last_build.last_build = 1 GROUP BY build.status

query.name: stat-project-builds
query.comment: Stats about the last project builds
query.sql: SELECT build.status AS status, COUNT(build.id) AS cnt, SUM(build.pass_count) AS pass_count, SUM(build.fail_count) AS fail_count, SUM(build.timeout_count) AS timeout_count, SUM(build.test_duration) AS test_duration, SUM(build.build_duration) AS build_duration, SUM(build.sys_time) AS sys_time, SUM(build.user_time) AS user_time FROM porion_last_build AS last_build INNER JOIN porion_build AS build ON last_build.build_id = build.id WHERE last_build.last_build = 1 AND build.project_id = :project_id GROUP BY build.status
